title: PBA: Ginebra shifts into must-win mode after loss to Magnolia

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Jordan Murphy and Barangay Ginebra will now have to play like there’s no tomorrow after their bid to qualify for the PBA Governors’ Cup suffered a big blow with a 112-93 loss to Magnolia on Sunday. Murphy had 18 points, seven rebounds and three assists but the Gin Kings couldn’t recover after the Hotshots dominated early to take another blowout victory at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Ginebra dropped to 3-5, tied at the bottom with Meralco, needing to beat Phoenix and Blackwater for a chance at making the playoffs.
